title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
summaryZh: 聖經指出人心充滿了各樣邪惡與詭詐，因不認識神而昏昧剛硬。
lines: Dig deep into your heart tonight in your thinking.
今晚在你的思想中，深深地挖掘你的內心。
The Bible says, "Prepare to meet thy God."
聖經說：「你當預備迎見你的神」。
And before you can prepare to meet God, your heart has to be right and your heart has to be touched by the Holy Spirit.
在你預備迎見神之前，你的心必須是對的，你的心必須被聖靈觸摸。
Now what does the Bible teach about the heart?
那麼，聖經對人心有什麼教導呢？
The Bible teaches that our hearts are sinful.
聖經教導我們，我們的心是有罪的。
We're born with it from Adam and Eve.
我們從亞當和夏娃那裡生來就帶著罪。
It's passed on from generation to generation.
And the Bible says, first of all, that our hearts are full of evil imagination.
聖經首先說，我們的心充滿了邪惡的想像。
Proverbs 6:18, "A heart that deviseth wicked imagination."
And then secondly, the Bible says the heart is desperately wicked and deceitful.
其次，聖經說人心是極其邪惡和詭詐的。
Jeremiah 17:9, "The heart is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked.
耶利米書 17:9：「人心比萬物都詭詐，壞到極處。
That's what the Bible thinks of your heart.
這就是聖經對你內心的看法。
That's what God thinks about your heart and my heart.
這就是神對你我內心的看法。
The Bible says the heart is far from God in Matthew 15.
馬太福音第十五章中，聖經說人心遠離神。
"This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth and honoreth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me."
「這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我。」
How many of us go to church and sing?
我們當中有多少人去教會唱歌？
How many of us go to church and listen to the clergyman?
我們當中有多少人去教會聽牧職人員講道？
How many of us outwardly live a fairly good life, but our heart is far from God?
我們當中有多少人外表上過著相當不錯的生活，但我們的心卻遠離神？
We don't have that experience with Christ in which He's in our hearts all day long.
我們沒有與基督的那種經歷，就是祂整天都在我們心裡。
And we think about Him and pray to Him and He's close to us, but He should be.
我們思想祂，向祂禱告，而且祂親近我們——但祂本該如此親近我們。
And we're not bearing in our bodies and in our lives the fruit of the Spirit which is love and joy and peace, and gentleness, faithfulness.
我們在我們的身體和生活中也沒有結出聖靈的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、溫柔、信實。
And then the Bible says that our hearts are a treasury of evil.
然後聖經說，我們的心是邪惡的寶庫。
Mark 7, Jesus said, "For within, out of the heart proceed evil thoughts."
馬可福音第七章，耶穌說：「因為從裡面，就是從人心裡，發出惡念。」
Evil thoughts come from the heart.
You might commit adultery with your body, but it starts in the heart and in the mind.
你可能用身體犯了姦淫，但它是從內心和思想開始的。
And fornications, and murders and thefts, and covetousness and wickedness and deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride and foolishness.
還有苟合、凶殺、偷盜、貪婪、邪惡、詭詐、淫蕩、嫉妒、謗讟、驕傲、狂妄。
All these things the Bible said, Jesus said, come from the heart.
聖經說，耶穌說，這一切事都是從心裡發出來的。
So, the most important thing in the world for you tonight is to be sure that your heart is right with God and that you have been forgiven of all those things.
所以，今晚對你來說世上最重要的事情，就是確定你的心在神面前是對的，並且你這一切的罪都已被赦免。
And how many today have darkened hearts?
今天有多少人的心是昏昧的？
I'm sometimes absolutely amazed at their ignorance of the world and their ignorance comes from the fact that they don't know God.
我有時對他們對這個世界的無知感到絕對地驚訝，而他們的無知來自於他們不認識神這個事實。
They don't know God's plan for the ages and so they make so many mistakes because their heart is dark, and Satan has blinded their eyes.
他們不知道神歷代的計畫，所以他們犯了那麼多錯誤，因為他們的心是黑暗的，撒但蒙蔽了他們的眼睛。
And many times, I've talked to many people who have very little education, but they know God.
很多時候，我和許多沒受過什麼教育的人交談，但他們認識神。
And they know more about what's wrong and how to right it than those people with all the brilliant education.
他們比那些受過優良教育的人更懂得什麼是錯的，以及如何去糾正它。
You see, there's something wrong with us that we don't recognize in the world in which we live.
你看，我們身上出了些問題，而在我們所處的世界裡我們卻沒有察覺。
Our world doesn't want to take into account that God exists or that man is made in the image of God.
我們的世界不願把神的存在考慮進去，也不願承認人是按著神的形像造的。
His heart is made in God's image and made for fellowship with God, and without God it's dark.
他的心是按著神的形像造的，是為了與神相交而造的，沒有神，心就是黑暗的。
You see, the devil darkens our understanding.
你看，魔鬼使我們的悟性昏昧。
Dulls the conscience and defiles the heart.
遲鈍了良心，污穢了內心。
And then the Bible says we have unbelieving hearts.
然後聖經說我們有不信的心。
"Take heed, brethren, lest there be any among you with an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God," Hebrews, the third chapter.
「弟兄們，你們要謹慎，免得你們中間或有人存著不信的惡心，把永生神離棄了。」希伯來書第三章。
And then our hearts are blind.
然後我們的心是瞎眼的。
Ephesians 4, "Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them because of the blindness of their heart."
以弗所書第四章：「他們心地昏昧，與神所賜的生命隔絕了，都因自己無知，心裡剛硬。」
